$comment: Machine-readable registry of the standard resource property vocabulary (D-45, closes G-6). The canonical prose form is SPEC.md § Resource Property Vocabulary; an SDK test (sdk/src/__tests__/resource-properties.test.ts) keeps the two consistent, so drift fails CI. Semantics notes are descriptive only: they record the documented meaning and existing provider latitude, and never settle a semantic the spec leaves undefined. Known-type vocabularies are OPEN — providers MAY expose extension properties; tooling warns (never errors) on properties outside this registry. Unknown resource types have no vocabulary here and stay fully open (L-4).

postgres.url: Fully-formed connection string (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname); TLS mode is provider latitude
postgres.host: Hostname or address the database is reachable at
postgres.name: Name of the provisioned database
